site_title: BotUI — open-source UI components for agent products
site_description: Copy-and-own UI components for agent products. Install with npx, then the code is yours. MIT licensed.
hero_title: UI components for things that think.
hero_lede: Loading states, streaming indicators, agent status — the surfaces an agent product lives on. Install one with npx, and the code lands in your repo. No runtime dependency, nothing to keep current. Read it, change it, delete the name.
hero_also: Also works with shadcn, against the same registry:
components_note: Read from /registry.json — the same document the CLI installs from.
components_error: Could not read /registry.json — {reason}. The registry is served from this site, so this is the site being broken rather than the component.
css_refused: This motion is a highlight moving down the field, and a per-dot delay can only offset a phase — so the CSS renderer refuses it rather than showing something else.
why_own_body: The registry ships the real source files. What lands in components/botui/ is the same text as the repository, and a test in CI proves it byte for byte.
why_version_body: There is no runtime dependency to upgrade and nothing that can break under you. When BotUI ships something better, you take the diff when you want to.
why_layers_body: Lattice, traversal, brightness envelope, dot polygon, renderer. Each is a table you can extend without touching the layers above.
scope_field_shape: Changes the outline of the whole field
scope_motion: Hover or focus a card to play it
showcase_intro: Add BotUI's loading indicator to this project.
showcase_note: Your settings, as props — only what you changed.
